step1.title: Why Dubai?
step1.description: Investing in Dubai offers a stable economy, strong government rules, and a safe, fast-growing environment. The city's tax-free property ownership, excellent rental returns, and steady demand from locals and visitors bring in foreign investors.
step1.fullDescription: Dubai's infrastructure, world-class lifestyle, and fast developing communities generate tremendous long-term value. Additionally, investors benefit from the Dubai Land Department's clear procedures, which guarantee secure transactions. With all of that Dubai offers a dependable, profitable, and globally renowned real estate market.

step2.title: Know the Basics
step2.description: Investing in Dubai is straightforward, but knowing the basic rules makes the process smooth. Foreign buyers can purchase property freely in designated freehold areas, meaning you fully own the property and the land beneath it.
step2.fullDescription: Buyers only need a valid passport to begin, and residents can use their Emirates ID or visa for additional benefits. Dubai has no property tax or capital gains tax, and fees are transparent. Financing is available for foreigners through local banks, with down payments starting from 20–25%. Understanding these essentials helps you invest confidently and avoid delays.

step3.title: Buy With Confidence
step3.description: Once you choose a property, the purchase process is fast and structured. Buyer and seller sign a simple agreement (Form F) and place a security deposit. Then an NOC is issued by the developer to confirm the property is clear of any dues.
step3.fullDescription: The final step is visiting a trustee office to transfer ownership, pay the remaining balance, and receive the official title deed from the Dubai Land Department. If you buy off-plan, all payments go into a regulated escrow account for full protection. After the transfer, you can register for utilities and start renting or moving in immediately.

step4.title: MR. PROPERTY Has Your Back
step4.description: At MR. PROPERTY, we simplify the entire investment journey so you don't have to deal with the complication and paperwork mess in Dubai's real estate market.
step4.fullDescription: From choosing the right property to managing paperwork, inspections, negotiations, and transfers, our team handles everything with complete transparency and expertise. We work directly with developers, follow all DLD and RERA regulations, making sure your investment is secure and profitable. You can invest in Dubai with confidence, knowing your time, money, and peace of mind are always protected with MR. Property.

step1.title: Why Türkiye?
step1.description: Investing in real estate in Turkey gives you access to a market that moves because of real demand, not hype. The country's location, tourism, and young population keep the housing market active all year.
step1.fullDescription: You can find everything from simple city apartments to family projects and coastal homes in places like Istanbul, Antalya, and Bodrum. Foreign buyers also have a clear path to ownership, and some properties offer residency or even citizenship. It's a market with real opportunity, but you still need to understand the basics, because not every area works the same. With proper guidance, Turkey can offer solid long-term value.

step2.title: Prepare and Verify
step2.description: After you pick a property, the first step is making sure all the paperwork is clean. This means checking the title deed, the construction license, and confirming there are no debts on the unit.
step2.fullDescription: Most buyers sign a small reservation or a simple sales agreement and leave a deposit while these checks are done. Having someone experienced look at the documents is important, because missing one small detail can delay the whole purchase. When everything is clear, you can move forward without worry.

step3.title: Complete the Transfer
step3.description: Once the legal checks are finished, the official steps begin. You get a tax number, arrange your payments, and complete the valuation report if needed.
step3.fullDescription: When all documents are ready, you and the seller meet at the Land Registry Office to transfer the title. After the fees and remaining balance are paid, the TAPU is issued in your name. From that moment, the property is officially yours. You can then open the utilities, register the home, and start using it or renting it out right away.

step4.title: MR. PROPERTY Has Your Back
step4.description: At MR PROPERTY, we make sure the entire process stays simple and organized. We help you choose the right project, check every document, follow up with developers, and handle the transfer at the Land Registry until you receive your TAPU.
step4.fullDescription: We only work with trusted developers and follow every rule so you don't deal with stress or surprises. With our team beside you, you can buy property in Turkey knowing your time, your money, and your peace of mind are protected.
